description: This file contains utility functions for managing and selecting test files in a Cypress testing environment, including file discovery, filtering based on metadata, sorting, and command execution.

methods.name: grepCommand
methods.description: Constructs a grep command string to search for a word within test directory.

methods.name: grepFiles
methods.description: Executes a grep command and filters for test spec files.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Finds files matching a pattern within the test directory, including recursive directory traversal.

methods.name: getBaseTestFiles
methods.description: Retrieves base test files based on command-line arguments and metadata filters.

methods.name: getWeightedFiles
methods.description: Assigns weights to files based on metadata for sorting purposes.

methods.name: reorderFiles
methods.description: Reorders files based on specified weights.

methods.name: removeFromFiles
methods.description: Removes specified files from a list.

methods.name: getSortedTestFiles
methods.description: Main function to get sorted test files considering filters, environment, and metadata.

methods.name: getFilesByMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves files matching specific metadata tags.

methods.name: printMessage
methods.description: Prints a message with a list of files, formatted with chalk.

methods.name: getSkippedFiles
methods.description: Determines files to skip based on platform, browser, and headless/headed environment.
